_doc: OT PINMUX. No interrupts (alert only). Primary pin_io = the 47 MIO pads (mio_out_o/mio_oe_o out, mio_in_i in) — reproduces the auto-detector wiring byte-for-byte. aux_pin_groups adds the PERIPHERAL side for the pin-group closed loop: mio_to_periph_o (57 lines to peripherals, 'periph-out' qdev lines), periph_to_mio_i (75 lines from peripherals, 'periph-in' qdev lines), with periph_to_mio_oe_i tied all-ones (peripheral output-enables are the peripherals' own concern; the pinmux model only routes).
